decision_boundary: This package assembles evidence for a human reviewer. It makes no legal finding, does not declare any party guilty of anything, and triggers no external action.

detection_evidence: invoice volume well above the entity's own baseline
reciprocal invoicing between a small group of entities

summary.statement: In 2026-10, Orchid Trading Ltd (E017) issued 11 invoices, against a median of 3 per month over the 5 preceding months of record.

3 invoices issued between 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-21 form a closed chain E017 -> E021 -> E022 -> E017, totalling 1,425,000.00 currency units, none with a matching payment in the collected transaction records.
Of 12 invoices issued or received by Orchid Trading Ltd (E017) in 2026-10, 6 have no matching payment in the collected transaction records, totalling 1,027,740.29 currency units.
3 invoices issued by Orchid Trading Ltd (E017) carry a tax amount that differs from the reference-rate amount: INV-0258, INV-0261, INV-0264.
Invoice number ORC-2026-0107 appears on 2 invoices issued by Orchid Trading Ltd (E017) with different amounts (INV-0260, INV-0266).
